_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for anything that appears in both prose and structured data. Nothing here may be duplicated as a literal in an HTML file without scripts/build-seo.mjs verifying the two agree — see the price assertion in that script. If you change a price, change it HERE and run the script; it will tell you every visible string that no longer matches.
_trialNote: trialEligibility is recorded here so it is never silently promoted into offer markup. Apple decides eligibility per Apple ID, so an Offer — which can only state unconditional terms — must not mention the trial at all. The conditional wording lives in visible copy and in terms.html.

ratingFallback._comment: Used ONLY if the iTunes lookup is unreachable at build time. Committed so a network blip degrades to a stale-but-real number instead of dropping the AggregateRating block or emitting a zero. Refreshed automatically on every successful build.
